artifact: Algerian farmland MCR row25 selected-isolate qualification

primary.title: Emergence of Escherichia coli harbouring mcr-1 and mcr-3 genes in North West Algerian farmlands
primary.access: Publisher/indexed primary abstract reached through web search; author-uploaded article text and Table2 exposed in public HTML. Direct publisher open403; PDF not downloaded.

selected_isolate_collection.unit: bacterial isolates recovered under colistin selection; mixed species

detection.classification: enrichment and selective culture, species identification, then molecular characterisation
detection.gene_screen: real-time PCR for mcr-1 through mcr-5

endpoint.interpretation: composition of selected isolate collection, not environmental-sample or farm prevalence

source_qualification.issue: Article uses resistant-isolate language while reported MICs include2 and Methods threshold is susceptible≤2/resistant>2.
source_qualification.handling: Retain authors' collection label as provenance; do not mechanically recode every isolate or equate gene detection with uniform phenotype.

inference_limits: Eight isolates do not establish eight distinct positive environmental samples; 8/40 is not supported sample prevalence.
Isolate yield varies by matrix and may cluster within samples/sites.
No representative Algerian national or environmental prevalence inferred.
Proposed manure-to-soil/water movement remains a hypothesis, not demonstrated field transmission.
Original seed and historical totals unchanged; no new pooling.
